verdict.rationale: Requesty's first-party docs describe Fallback Policies that automatically retry a request with the next model in a chain when the primary fails (timeout, rate limit, or error), covering failover across models and providers. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how a policy is configured (UI or API fields, chain ordering, per-key scoping), and independent or hands-on corroboration that failover works in practice.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can configure automatic fallback to another model or provider when one fails

citations.quote: Fallback Policies automatically retry your requests with different models if one fails, ensuring your application stays reliable even when individual providers have issues.
If it fails (timeout, rate limit, error, etc.), the router immediately tries the next model in the chain.
